column1: # Alex stops the party in Mogall Forest and unsettles Mia.

column3: Easy. Don't go in loud.\nThey sleep in those trees,\nand they wake badly.{end_wait}
Who sleeps? What are you\nhiding in the forest?{end_wait}
People who woke wrong. We\nkeep them quiet and alive.{page_break}Don't judge how. There\nare worse ways.{end_wait}
Chains and gags. How\ncharming. A mercy?{end_wait}
It works. Say what you like\nabout the method. You\nwould have done the same.{end_wait}
Isaac, there are kids in\nthere. I can hear them.{end_wait}
Then you understand why we\ndon't open the door.\nChoose carefully.{end_wait}
